lines.zh: 面具戴歪了，我先去树后扶正。
lines.en: My mask slipped; I'll fix it behind that tree.

lines.zh: 我们三个排成一列，踩同一道脚印。
lines.en: The three of us walk in one line, sharing each footprint.

lines.zh: 草丛里有甜根，我的鼻子先到了。
lines.en: There are sweet roots in the grass; my nose got there first.

lines.zh: 别看我走得慢，我在数你的步子。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I'm counting your steps.

lines.zh: 蜡从我口袋漏出来，滴在鞋底。
lines.en: Wax leaks from my pocket and drips onto my soles.

lines.zh: 换过位置以后，我该往哪边走？
lines.en: After the swap, which way am I supposed to go?

lines.zh: 前面那只牛，面具尺寸不太对。
lines.en: That cow ahead, my mask for it fits badly.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，故意弄出点声响。
lines.en: I step on dry leaves and make a little noise on purpose.

lines.zh: 同伴落在后头，正学我甩尾巴。
lines.en: My companion lags behind, copying how I swing my tail.

lines.zh: 绕过这片麦田，别踩坏人家的苗。
lines.en: Let's skirt this wheat field and not crush the seedlings.

lines.zh: 我在找一块能坐下的软泥地。
lines.en: I'm looking for a patch of soft mud to sit in.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，前面好像有只猫。
lines.en: Steps softer now; there seems to be a cat ahead.

lines.zh: 蜡鞋底黏住草籽，越走越沉。
lines.en: My waxed soles collect seeds and grow heavier.

lines.zh: 我跟在你侧后方，这样看得清楚。
lines.en: I keep to your rear flank so I can see clearly.

lines.zh: 我把面具挪到后脑勺。
lines.en: I shift my mask to the back of my head.

lines.zh: 绕这条路，能捡到掉的东西。
lines.en: This path has dropped things worth picking up.

lines.zh: 摘下面具透口气，反正没人看。
lines.en: I take the mask off to breathe; nobody's watching.

lines.zh: 数到三，我们就换一次站位。
lines.en: Count to three, and we trade places again.

lines.zh: 这块蜡我嚼了半天，还是硬的。
lines.en: I've chewed this wax half the day and it's still hard.

lines.zh: 面具内侧有股旧皮革的味道。
lines.en: The inside of my mask smells of old leather.

lines.zh: 我在想你口袋里那瓶药水。
lines.en: I'm thinking about that potion in your pocket.

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得贴住了头。
lines.en: The wind has pressed my ears flat against my head.

lines.zh: 这个墙角不错，草长得很厚。
lines.en: This corner is decent; the grass grows thick.

lines.zh: 两只同伴在打盹，我负责看路。
lines.en: Both companions doze while I keep watch on the road.

lines.zh: 把玩偶翻过来，看看缝线在哪。
lines.en: I turn the little doll over to find its seam.

lines.zh: 滴一滴药剂，我的力气就涨一级。
lines.en: One drop of tonic and my strength rises a tier.

lines.zh: 面具的眼孔太小，看东西发暗。
lines.en: The eyeholes are too small; everything looks dim.

lines.zh: 我在磨牙，不是在想坏事。
lines.en: I'm grinding my teeth, not plotting anything.

lines.zh: 数一遍口袋：蜡、药、换物器。
lines.en: Inventory check: wax, tonic, swapper.

lines.zh: 谁把我的面具摆反了？真奇怪。
lines.en: Who set my mask down backwards? That's odd.

lines.zh: 我数着面具上的裂缝。
lines.en: I count the cracks in my mask.

lines.zh: 换物器在口袋里叮当响。
lines.en: The swapper rattles in my pocket.

lines.zh: 你的脸和我的面具，哪个更真？
lines.en: Your face or my mask, which one is more real?

lines.zh: 我歪着头，是在认你的鞋印。
lines.en: I tilt my head to memorize your boot prints.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，去过矿洞吧。
lines.en: You smell of iron rust; you've been in a mine.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我正在换一张脸。
lines.en: Don't blink; I'm changing to another face.

lines.zh: 面具下的我在笑，你看不见。
lines.en: Under the mask I'm grinning, and you can't tell.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，换不换？
lines.en: That thing in your hand, want to trade?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你走得最快。
lines.en: I stare because you're the fastest one here.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我好像有一张一样的。
lines.en: I think I have a mask of that face already.

lines.zh: 眼孔里看到的你，颜色有点淡。
lines.en: Through these eyeholes, your colors look faded.

lines.zh: 我凑近点，闻闻你是不是熟人。
lines.en: Let me lean in and sniff whether you're someone I know.

lines.zh: 你一直看我的面具，礼貌吗？
lines.en: You keep staring at my mask. Is that polite?

lines.zh: 我把面具抬高一点，好让你看清。
lines.en: I lift my mask a little so you can see better.

lines.zh: 面具裂了，这可比皮外伤贵。
lines.en: My mask cracked; that costs more than the wound.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的换手动作。
lines.en: You broke my swap mid-motion.

lines.zh: 蜡从裂缝里挤出来了。
lines.en: Wax squeezes out of the crack.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，面具挡了一半。
lines.en: I hunch my neck; the mask takes half of it.

lines.zh: 这力道，你手也震得麻吧。
lines.en: With that force, your arm must be numb too.

lines.zh: 同伴在叫，我听见了。
lines.en: My companion's calling; I hear it.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别踩那袋蜡。
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but don't step on the wax sack.

lines.zh: 我退进草里，换个方向。
lines.en: I slip into the grass and pick another angle.

lines.zh: 面具下我龇牙了，你看不见。
lines.en: Under the mask I'm baring teeth; you can't see.

lines.zh: 这口子不深，只是难补。
lines.en: The gash isn't deep, just hard to patch.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？我确实嚼得动。
lines.en: A carrot? I can certainly chew that.

lines.zh: 甜菜根递过来，我就跟你走三步。
lines.en: Hand me a beetroot and I'll follow three steps.

lines.zh: 这捆麦子闻着像晒过的午后。
lines.en: This bundle of wheat smells like a sun-dried afternoon.

lines.zh: 你拿浆果换我的蜡，划算。
lines.en: Berries for my wax, that's a fair trade.

lines.zh: 别晃，我看不清你手里是什么。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I can't see what you're holding.

lines.zh: 苹果核也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Even an apple core works; I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 吃了你的东西，我得回礼。
lines.en: If I eat your gift, I owe you something back.

lines.zh: 那瓶药剂再加一级，我更想要。
lines.en: That tonic, one tier stronger, I want it more.

lines.zh: 你先松手，我们再谈交换。
lines.en: Loosen your grip first, then we'll talk trade.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还含着蜡，等一会儿。
lines.en: I still have wax in my mouth; give me a moment.

lines.zh: 这个味道我记下了，很甜。
lines.en: I've memorized this taste; it's very sweet.

lines.zh: 别拿腐肉糊弄我，我是吃草的。
lines.en: Don't fob me off with rotten flesh; I eat plants.

lines.zh: 你把食物放地上，我就靠近。
lines.en: Set the food on the ground and I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 吃完这一口，我允许你摸面具。
lines.en: After this bite, you may touch the mask.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell that grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 给我一半，我就把面具摘了。
lines.en: Half of it, and the mask comes off.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的面具歪到耳朵了。
lines.en: One bump and my mask slid onto my ear.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，往左点。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail; shift left a little.

lines.zh: 三个挤在一条窄路上，难免。
lines.en: Three of us on one narrow path, it happens.

lines.zh: 别推，蜡会蹭到你衣服上。
lines.en: Don't shove; the wax will rub onto your clothes.

lines.zh: 我退半步，你就能过去了。
lines.en: I'll step back half a pace so you can pass.

lines.zh: 面具磕在你腰上，响了一声。
lines.en: My mask knocked against your hip with a click.

lines.zh: 这条道太窄，我们排成一队。
lines.en: This path is too narrow; let's go single file.

lines.zh: 撞完以后，我们算认识了吗？
lines.en: Now that we've bumped, are we acquainted?

lines.zh: 我壳不硬，别用肩膀顶我。
lines.en: I'm not armored; don't push me with your shoulder.

lines.zh: 站稳，我身后的同伴还没让开。
lines.en: Steady; the companion behind me hasn't moved aside.

lines.zh: 面具交换一下，就算成了。
lines.en: We swap masks, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 巢里铺软草，再压一层蜡。
lines.en: I'll line the nest with soft grass and seal it with wax.

lines.zh: 她数我的尾巴节数，数得很慢。
lines.en: She counts the segments of my tail, slowly.

lines.zh: 成对以后，我们走同一个方向。
lines.en: Paired up, we walk the same direction.

lines.zh: 别在旁边看，这事要安静。
lines.en: Don't watch from there; this needs quiet.

lines.zh: 我衔来最亮的一块蜡给她。
lines.en: I bring her the brightest lump of wax.

lines.zh: 两只小的挤在草窝里睡着。
lines.en: Two little ones sleep curled in the grass nest.

lines.zh: 配偶的叫声比我低半度。
lines.en: My mate's call sits half a note below mine.

lines.zh: 换过面具，她就认得出我了。
lines.en: Once we trade masks, she can recognize me.

lines.zh: 我们头顶着头，谁也不先动。
lines.en: We press brow to brow; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 这根蜡条掉了，我捡起来。
lines.en: This wax strip fell; I'll pick it up.

lines.zh: 地上有张旧面具，还能用。
lines.en: An old mask on the ground, still usable.

lines.zh: 我把换物器塞进腰带里。
lines.en: I tuck the swapper into my belt.

lines.zh: 只捡有用的，石头就留下。
lines.en: I only take what's useful; the stones stay.

lines.zh: 这枚药瓶是满的，运气不错。
lines.en: This vial is full, lucky me.

lines.zh: 同伴丢的东西，我替他收着。
lines.en: My companion dropped this; I'll hold it for him.

lines.zh: 捡到一根羽毛，可以插面具上。
lines.en: A feather, I can stick it on my mask.

lines.zh: 别捡那根，那是我藏的。
lines.en: Leave that one; I hid it there.

lines.zh: 两样东西叠在一起，我挑轻的。
lines.en: Two things stacked together; I take the lighter.

lines.zh: 口袋满了，我用牙咬着走。
lines.en: My pockets are full, so I carry this in my teeth.

lines.zh: 它先动手的，不是我。
lines.en: It struck first, not me.

lines.zh: 那只东西踩坏了我的蜡堆。
lines.en: That creature trampled my pile of wax.

lines.zh: 我只想赶它走，不下狠手。
lines.en: I only want to drive it off, not hurt it.

lines.zh: 面具借我这张脸，壮壮胆。
lines.en: I borrow this mask's face to steady my nerve.

lines.zh: 三对一，我们才敢上前。
lines.en: Three against one, only then do we step up.

lines.zh: 它抢了同伴的甜根。
lines.en: It stole my companion's sweet root.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，先看清它的爪。
lines.en: I crouch low and study its claws first.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我要过去讨个说法。
lines.en: Out of my way; I'm going to settle this.

lines.zh: 这一架打完，蜡还得重做。
lines.en: After this fight I'll have to remake the wax.

lines.zh: 它要是退，我就不追了。
lines.en: If it backs off, I won't chase it.

lines.zh: 绕到它侧面，面具别掉。
lines.en: Circle to its flank, and don't drop the mask.

lines.zh: 它比我高，得从低处打。
lines.en: It's taller than me; I'll strike from below.

lines.zh: 同伴堵住后路，我来牵制。
lines.en: My companion blocks the retreat; I'll hold its attention.

lines.zh: 数到三我们就一起扑。
lines.en: On three, we pounce together.

lines.zh: 它的影子在墙上，位置我看清了。
lines.en: Its shadow is on the wall; I know where it stands.

lines.zh: 先咬脚踝，让它转过来。
lines.en: Bite the ankle first and make it turn.

lines.zh: 我退两步，等它扑空。
lines.en: I back off two steps and let it lunge past.

lines.zh: 蜡抹在爪上，抓得更牢。
lines.en: Wax on my claws gives a firmer grip.

lines.zh: 面具吓唬它一下，也许有用。
lines.en: A flash of the mask might scare it off.

lines.zh: 别急，我先让它走近一点。
lines.en: Not yet; let it come a little closer.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过去，只够刮破皮。
lines.en: My claws rake past; barely enough to break skin.

lines.zh: 我把蜡甩它眼睛里。
lines.en: I fling hot wax into its eyes.

lines.zh: 这一下用头顶的，不重。
lines.en: This one's a headbutt; it won't be heavy.

lines.zh: 牙咬住它袖口，扯了一下。
lines.en: My teeth catch its cuff and I pull once.

lines.zh: 面具边缘磕它脸，算我赢半分。
lines.en: The mask's rim clips its face, half a win.

lines.zh: 它比我壮，我只打腿弯。
lines.en: It's stronger; I go for the back of the knee.

lines.zh: 打完我退开，喘口气。
lines.en: I hit, then step away to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我的爪子短，可我们有三只。
lines.en: My claws are short, but there are three of us.

lines.zh: 这一爪我带上了蜡，黏住它。
lines.en: Wax coats this swipe, so it sticks to it.

lines.zh: 别笑，我打得过就继续打。
lines.en: Don't laugh; if I'm winning I keep swinging.

lines.zh: 三只一起睁眼，草叶还在晃。
lines.en: Three of us open our eyes; the grass still sways.

lines.zh: 这地方生成得不错，有树荫。
lines.en: This spot spawned well, there's shade here.

lines.zh: 面具先扣上，再站起来。
lines.en: Mask on first, then I stand up.

lines.zh: 我们出生时就是三个。
lines.en: We were born as three.

lines.zh: 晨雾还没散，我先闻了闻土。
lines.en: The morning mist hasn't lifted; I sniff the soil.

lines.zh: 身边两只还在打哈欠。
lines.en: The two beside me are still yawning.

lines.zh: 从土里拱出来，毛上都是泥。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil with mud in my fur.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找块蜡压惊。
lines.en: First thing: find a lump of wax to calm down.

lines.zh: 主世界的草真软，比想的软。
lines.en: Overworld grass is soft, softer than I expected.

lines.zh: 我们三个站好，往林子走。
lines.en: The three of us line up and head for the trees.

lines.zh: 面具怕火，我不得不后退。
lines.en: My mask fears fire; I have to fall back.

lines.zh: 草接住了我，面具没碎。
lines.en: The grass caught me; the mask didn't crack.

lines.zh: 水里我的蜡浮起来了。
lines.en: My wax floats up in the water.

lines.zh: 气浪掀飞面具，我追着跑。
lines.en: The blast blows my mask off; I run after it.

lines.zh: 箭钉在面具上，像根新角。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my mask like a new horn.

lines.zh: 咒语绕开我，去找面具了。
lines.en: The spell bypasses me and seeks the mask instead.

lines.zh: 饿了，我连树皮都啃。
lines.en: Starving, I'd gnaw even tree bark.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，面具成了导线。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my mask becomes a conduit.

lines.zh: 虚空里我还在摸我的面具。
lines.en: Falling through the void, I still reach for my mask.
